predictions.rationale: The market splits this almost exactly (39/22/40), with Barcelona a fraction ahead. Barcelona are without Koundé, Eric García and Christensen at the back, while PSG lose Nuno Mendes but rested seven expected starters at the weekend; both sides lean slightly toward PSG and both are unconfirmed. Not enough to overturn a line this flat, so we stay with the hair-width favourite at minimum confidence and expect goals.
predictions.disagreement: Tipsters are split three ways (Covers and CBS back PSG, bets.com.au Barcelona, Football Whispers and footballpredictions a draw); the near-unanimous call is on goals, not the winner.

predictions.rationale: Market makes Bayern Munich a 47% home favourite. Bayern are without Olise (suspended) and Musiala, with Neuer a late fitness call, while Arsenal miss Saliba and Hincapié but have won 10 of 11 and kept two UCL clean sheets.
